items.headline: RBI MPC keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.25%
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee maintained the repo rate at 5.25%, aligning with expectations and aiming to balance resilient growth with a contained inflation outlook.

items.headline: India's July CPI inflation expected to rise to 4.50%
items.summary: A Reuters poll forecasts India's July consumer price inflation to increase to 4.50% year-on-year, potentially exceeding RBI's 4% target for the second consecutive month, driven by elevated crude oil prices.

items.headline: India's net direct tax collection up 23.09% till August 10
items.summary: The central government's net direct tax collection witnessed a robust increase of 23.09%, exceeding Rs. 8.11 lakh crore until August 10 in the current fiscal year.

items.headline: Fitch reaffirms India's 'BBB-' sovereign credit rating
items.summary: Fitch Ratings has reaffirmed India's sovereign credit rating at 'BBB-' for the twentieth consecutive year, though it highlighted potential risks to fiscal spending.

items.headline: Taxation Laws Amendment Bill 2026 introduced in Lok Sabha

items.headline: Global markets cautious, Asian markets mixed, US futures flat

items.headline: Brent crude futures near $90 amid Strait of Hormuz tensions

items.headline: Indian benchmarks decline, Financials and Glass sectors hit while IT and Pharma show strength
items.summary: On Tuesday, Indian equity benchmarks saw declines, with Nifty 50 falling 0.46% and Sensex dropping 0.49%. Financials, particularly banks and private banks, were the hardest-hit sectors alongside the Glass sector. In contrast, IT and Pharma demonstrated relative strength, while Auto, FMCG, Metal, and Realty faced pressure. Smallcap stocks outperformed midcaps and largecaps.
